# Comments Analyzer Agent

The Apify actor [`apify/comments-analyzer-agent`](https://apify.com/apify/comments-analyzer-agent) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.6**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Prevent PR disasters with AI sentiment analysis. Monitor comments across TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram to detect negative sentiment, toxic content, and potential crises before they escalate. Automate your workflow and send a message when something needs your immediate attention.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Comment $0.001 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/comments-analyzer-agent) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-comments-analyzer-agent@0.0.6#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      postUrl: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `postUrl` | string | yes |  | Post URL — The URL of the post to scrape comments from. |
| `maxComments` | integer | yes | `1` | Maximum number of comments — The maximum number of comments to scrape from each post. If not specified, all comments will be scraped. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
